sentences.text: Fajar bekerja di dapur restoran setelah lulus sebagai sarjana tata boga.

sentences.text: Koki muda di restoran itu jarang berani bersuara saat rapat menu dengan pemilik.
sentences.en: The young cooks at that restaurant rarely dare to speak up in menu meetings with the owner.
sentences.ko: 그 식당의 젊은 요리사들은 주인과의 메뉴 회의에서 좀처럼 말을 못 해요.

sentences.text: Radio tua milik Lestari masih bisa bersuara meskipun antenanya patah.
sentences.en: Lestari's old radio can still make sound even though its antenna is broken.
sentences.ko: 레스타리의 낡은 라디오는 안테나가 부러졌는데도 아직 소리가 나요.

sentences.text: Kepala koki menegaskan bahwa semua orang wajib memakai penutup rambut.
sentences.en: The head chef made it clear that everyone must wear a hairnet.
sentences.ko: 주방장은 모두 반드시 머리망을 써야 한다고 못 박았어요.

sentences.text: Penjual itu menegaskan bahwa vas biru di mejanya asli buatan tangan.
sentences.en: The seller insisted that the blue vase on his table is genuinely handmade.
sentences.ko: 그 상인은 자기 테이블의 파란 꽃병이 진짜 수제품이라고 강조했어요.

sentences.text: Tukang angkut beras yang perkasa itu memikul dua karung sekaligus ke gudang dapur.
sentences.en: The mighty rice porter carried two sacks at once into the kitchen storeroom.
sentences.ko: 힘센 쌀 배달꾼이 자루 두 개를 한꺼번에 주방 창고로 날랐어요.

sentences.text: Patung kayu berbentuk kuda yang perkasa jadi barang termahal di lapak Lestari.
sentences.en: A wooden statue of a mighty horse is the most expensive item at Lestari's stall.
sentences.ko: 힘찬 말 모양의 나무 조각상이 레스타리 노점에서 가장 비싼 물건이에요.

sentences.text: Kucing liar di belakang dapur menggeram saat Fajar membuang sisa ikan.
sentences.en: The stray cat behind the kitchen growled when Fajar threw out the fish scraps.
sentences.ko: 파자르가 생선 찌꺼기를 버릴 때 주방 뒤 길고양이가 으르렁거렸어요.

sentences.text: Anjing penjaga lapak sebelah menggeram setiap kali ada orang memegang dagangan.
sentences.en: The guard dog at the next stall growls whenever someone touches the goods.
sentences.ko: 옆 노점 경비견은 누가 물건을 만질 때마다 으르렁거려요.

sentences.text: Koki baru dari kota lain butuh waktu untuk beradaptasi dengan dapur yang sempit.
sentences.en: The new cook from another city needs time to adapt to the cramped kitchen.
sentences.ko: 다른 도시에서 온 새 요리사는 좁은 주방에 적응할 시간이 필요해요.

sentences.text: Lestari harus beradaptasi dengan pembeli muda yang suka menawar lewat pesan.
sentences.en: Lestari has to adapt to young buyers who like to haggle by message.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 메시지로 흥정하기 좋아하는 젊은 손님들에게 적응해야 해요.

sentences.text: Setiap hari Fajar menempuh perjalanan satu jam naik motor ke restoran.
sentences.en: Every day Fajar makes an hour-long motorbike trip to the restaurant.
sentences.ko: 파자르는 매일 오토바이로 한 시간을 달려 식당에 가요.

sentences.text: Banyak pengunjung menempuh perjalanan jauh demi pasar loak yang hanya buka hari Minggu.
sentences.en: Many visitors travel a long way for the flea market that only opens on Sundays.
sentences.ko: 많은 방문객이 일요일에만 여는 벼룩시장을 찾아 먼 길을 와요.
